source_files: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.11816 (HTML appendix, 'Ego4D Narration Dialogue Stream Example')
access_used: public sample in paper/repo/card only (full data needs approval on the gated HF repo chenjoya/videollm-online-chat-ego4d-134k; our token is not on the authorised list, HTTP 403 on refined_narration_stream_val.json)
note: No record could be downloaded. The only verbatim published samples are the paper's schematic stream (each [F] is one 2 fps frame; the model emits a narration turn only on some frames and stays silent otherwise) and the refinement few-shot pairs that turn Ego4D 'C …' narrations into the released second-person text. No timestamps are published, so timelines are empty.

examples.title: Paper appendix: narration dialogue stream (schematic, frames as [F])
examples.raw: • Ego4D Narration Dialogue Stream Example: [System] User: Please watch the video and narrate the video in real-time. [F] [F] Assistant: C walks around a room. [F][F] [F] Assistant: C picks up a wire from the floor. [F][F][F] [F] Assistant: C pulls out a wire from a wall. [F][F][F][F] [F] Assistant: C looks around a room. [F][F] …

examples.title: Refinement few-shot pairs: 'C looks around.' → 'You look around.'
examples.raw:
("Please help me to refine the text, e.g., [C looks around.] -> [You look around.]"
"In the text, There are many uppercase letters to denote persons. Rewrite the sentence to avoid these uppercase letters, improve the text quality, make the text clear and concise. "
"For example:
[C looks around.] -> [You look around.]
[A man X watches the phone.] -> [A man watches the phone.]
"
f"[C plays a piano, and a woman O comes to him.] -> [You play a piano, and a woman comes to you.]
[Man A approaches C] -> [A man approaches you.]

Now, please refine [{narration['text']}] -> ?, make the answer in [].")
